title: Export recordings and enforce retention
alias: list recordings, copy the expired ones out, then DELETE
summary: A pass lists every call recording across pages, copies each one older than your retention window to storage you control, and then deletes it from SignalWire. Nothing is deleted that was not copied first.
scenario: A shop that must keep call recordings for a year in its own archive and nowhere else

folds: sol correction (S3-compatible storage is not our product)
evidence: tools/openapi/rest.json GET /api/relay/rest/recordings (links.next pagination; every variant carries id, created_at, url, duration_in_seconds); DELETE /api/relay/rest/recordings/{id} 204
docs platform/media-protection: protected media requires API auth to fetch
docs compatibility-api/cxml/reference/voice/record (storageUrl) is the record-time alternative; SWML exposes none
